{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Tailored wool-blend midi skirt, A-line cut hitting mid-calf, color #6F4E37 (warm mocha), fabric with a fine herringbone weave.
Lightweight structured blazer in double-faced cotton-poplin, boxy shoulder and relaxed fit through the hips, color #8C7B70 (dusty taupe), crisp woven material.
Classic pointed-toe leather pumps on a 7cm heel, almond silhouette, color #5A3A2A (espresso brown), smooth full-grain leather.
Delicate gold-toned link bracelet and matching stud earrings in 14k yellow gold plated brass.

This ensemble works because it perfectly balances professional polish with the requested focus on skirts, using structured silhouettes that are flattering for a tall frame without being restrictive. The earthy palette of mocha, taupe, and espresso harmonizes beautifully with warm skin tones while remaining versatile enough for an office autumn setting where temperatures may drop. By choosing a herringbone skirt and a tailored blazer, the outfit achieves the neat business dress code while maintaining comfort throughout the workday."}
